digest.component_or_area: store initialization and environment identity management
propositions: Tracker re-clone without carrying git-ignored .env-id/.opcert-key files causes a fresh environment identity to be minted, orphaning all attestations signed by the prior environment
Minting a new .env-id into a store already holding events stamped with a different env_id is currently silent, causing the problem to surface only later at attestation verification gates
The mint process reads env_id from event files on disk but does not consult this prior identity before generating a fresh uuid, making re-identification undetectable at the point of occurrence
Multi-environment stores (multiple clones sharing tickets) must not refuse minting, as clone-B legitimately needs its own identity when mounting clone-A's events

The fix implements loud warning with override flag (REBAR_ALLOW_ENV_REIDENTIFY=1) on re-identification, plus fsck ENV_ID_MISMATCH detection scoped by author to detect same-person re-clones without false-positives on team stores
